description: Source code for the 'git daemon' service, implementing network listening, connection handling, repository access control, and service management.

methods.name: lookup_hostname
methods.description: Resolves hostname to canonical name and IP address, supporting IPv4 and IPv6.

methods.name: get_canon_hostname
methods.description: Returns the canonical hostname, performing lookup if necessary.

methods.name: get_ip_address
methods.description: Returns the IP address of the host, performing lookup if necessary.

methods.name: logreport
methods.description: Logs messages to syslog or stderr based on configuration.

methods.name: logerror
methods.description: Logs error messages.

methods.name: loginfo
methods.description: Logs informational messages if verbose mode is enabled.

methods.name: daemon_die
methods.description: Handles fatal errors by logging and exiting.

methods.name: path_ok
methods.description: Validates and constructs repository paths based on configuration and security checks.

methods.name: run_access_hook
methods.description: Executes an external hook script to determine access permissions.

methods.name: run_service
methods.description: Executes a requested service after validation and access checks.

methods.name: copy_to_log
methods.description: Copies output from a file descriptor to the log.

methods.name: run_service_command
methods.description: Runs a child process for a service command and logs errors.

methods.name: upload_pack
methods.description: Handles 'git upload-pack' service requests.

methods.name: upload_archive
methods.description: Handles 'git upload-archive' service requests.

methods.name: receive_pack
methods.description: Handles 'git receive-pack' service requests.

methods.name: enable_service
methods.description: Enables a specified service.

methods.name: make_service_overridable
methods.description: Sets whether a service can be overridden.

methods.name: parse_host_and_port
methods.description: Parses host and port from a string.

methods.name: sanitize_client
methods.description: Sanitizes client input for filesystem paths.

methods.name: canonicalize_client
methods.description: Canonicalizes client input for filesystem paths.

methods.name: parse_host_arg
methods.description: Parses host argument from extended request.

methods.name: parse_extra_args
methods.description: Parses additional arguments from extended request.

methods.name: setup_named_sock
methods.description: Creates and binds a socket for listening, supporting IPv4 and IPv6.

methods.name: socksetup
methods.description: Sets up listening sockets based on configuration.

methods.name: service_loop
methods.description: Main loop accepting and handling incoming connections.

methods.name: cmd_main
methods.description: Main entry point for the 'git daemon' command, parsing arguments and starting server.
